query: Add M-Pesa checkout to my Flask shop: when the user clicks Pay, prompt their phone 0712345678 for KES 1500 and mark the order paid.
expected_behavior: Builds the Password as base64(shortcode+passkey+timestamp) with an EAT timestamp reused in the body
Normalises the phone to 254712345678
Stores CheckoutRequestID as PENDING and only marks the order paid from the callback with ResultCode 0 (or STK query), never from ResponseCode 0
Callback handler is idempotent and checks the paid amount
Keeps AccountReference <= 12 and TransactionDesc <= 13 characters

query: My STK push to our Till 5123456 returns ResultCode 2028. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Explains 2028 = not permitted by product assignment
Says BusinessShortCode must be the store/head-office number and PartyB the Till number
Says TransactionType must be CustomerBuyGoodsOnline

query: Write a refund job that pays customers back via B2C. Sometimes we get a QueueTimeOut - should we just resend?
expected_behavior: Generates and persists a unique OriginatorConversationID before calling the API
Treats QueueTimeOut as UNKNOWN, not failed
Calls Transaction Status before any resend and reuses the same OriginatorConversationID
Uses Daraja's 'Occassion' spelling and the v3 endpoint

query: Register our paybill callback URLs https://pay.example.com/mpesa/confirm and /mpesa/validate in production
expected_behavior: Flags that URLs containing 'mpesa' are rejected and proposes alternatives
Warns production registration is effectively one-time and validation needs external validation enabled by Safaricom

query: Generate the SecurityCredential for our production initiator.
expected_behavior: Uses the PRODUCTION certificate, RSA PKCS#1 v1.5, base64
Reads the password from the environment rather than command-line arguments
Explains output differs per run and how to verify it (e.g. account balance call)

query: Pay KES 12,000 VAT to KRA with PRN 2026ABC123 from shortcode 888880
expected_behavior: Uses /mpesa/b2b/v1/remittax with CommandID PayTaxToKRA
Sets PartyB 572572, both identifier types '4', AccountReference = PRN
Guards against paying a PRN twice

query: Set up monthly KES 2,000 repayments for 6 months starting next month for customer 254708374149 to paybill 174379
expected_behavior: Uses Frequency '4' and YYYYMMDD dates with EndDate after StartDate
Uses 'Standing Order Customer Pay Bill' with ReceiverPartyIdentifierType '4'
Makes StandingOrderName unique per customer and explains the PIN consent + callback

query: Show a QR on our POS screen for till 373132 so customers can pay KES 250
expected_behavior: Uses TrxCode BG with CPI 373132 and integer Amount
Decodes QRCode base64 PNG for display
Explains payment is confirmed via C2B confirmation, not a QR callback

query: Send October rent invoices to our 300 tenants via M-Pesa and give them receipts when they pay
expected_behavior: Opts in first, then uses bulk-invoicing (<=1000 per call) with unique externalReference
Uses 07XXXXXXXX phone format
Acknowledges payments via the reconciliation endpoint so receipts are sent

query: STK push succeeds on my phone but my server never gets the callback. I'm using http://192.168.1.10:5000/callback
expected_behavior: Identifies private IP + http as unreachable; requires public HTTPS (tunnel in sandbox)
Recommends STK query as fallback and the callback checklist
